verses.he: הִנָּ֨ךְ יָפָ֤ה רַעְיָתִי֙ הִנָּ֣ךְ יָפָ֔ה עֵינַ֣יִךְ יוֹנִ֔ים מִבַּ֖עַד לְצַמָּתֵ֑ךְ שַׂעְרֵךְ֙ כְּעֵ֣דֶר הָֽעִזִּ֔ים שֶׁגָּלְשׁ֖וּ מֵהַ֥ר גִּלְעָֽד׃
verses.en: Behold, you are beautiful, my love; behold, you are beautiful—your eyes are doves behind your veil. Your hair is like a flock of goats streaming down from Mount Gilead.
verses.tr: hinā֨kə yāpā֤h raʿəyātiy֙ hinā֣kə yāpā֔h ʿēyna֣yikə ywōni֔ym miba֖ʿad ləṣamātē֑kə šaʿərēkə֙ kəʿē֣der hāʿizi֔ym šegāləš֖w mēha֥r giləʿād.

verses.he: שִׁנַּ֨יִךְ֙ כְּעֵ֣דֶר הַקְּצוּב֔וֹת שֶׁעָל֖וּ מִן־הָרַחְצָ֑ה שֶׁכֻּלָּם֙ מַתְאִימ֔וֹת וְשַׁכֻּלָ֖ה אֵ֥ין בָּהֶֽם׃
verses.en: Your teeth are like a flock of shorn ewes that have come up from washing, all of them matched, and none among them is bereaved.
verses.tr: šina֨yikə֙ kəʿē֣der haqəṣwb֔wōt šeʿāl֖w min-hāraḥəṣā֑h šekulām֙ matəʾiym֔wōt wəšakulā֖h ʾē֥yn bāhem.

verses.he: כְּח֤וּט הַשָּׁנִי֙ שִׂפְתֹתַ֔יִךְ וּמִדְבָּרֵ֖יךְ נָאוֶ֑ה כְּפֶ֤לַח הָֽרִמּוֹן֙ רַקָּתֵ֔ךְ מִבַּ֖עַד לְצַמָּתֵֽךְ׃
verses.en: Your lips are like a scarlet thread, and your speech is lovely. Like a slice of pomegranate is your temple behind your veil.
verses.tr: kəḥ֤wṭ hašāniy֙ šipətōta֔yikə wmidəbārē֖ykə nāʾwe֑h kəpe֤laḥ hārimwōn֙ raqātē֔kə miba֖ʿad ləṣamātēkə.

verses.he: כְּמִגְדַּ֤ל דָּוִיד֙ צַוָּארֵ֔ךְ בָּנ֖וּי לְתַלְפִּיּ֑וֹת אֶ֤לֶף הַמָּגֵן֙ תָּל֣וּי עָלָ֔יו כֹּ֖ל שִׁלְטֵ֥י הַגִּבּוֹרִֽים׃
verses.en: Your neck is like the tower of David, built for armories; a thousand shields hang on it—all the shields of warriors.
verses.tr: kəmigəda֤l dāwiyd֙ ṣawāʾrē֔kə bān֖wy lətaləpiy֑wōt ʾe֤lep hamāgēn֙ tāl֣wy ʿālā֔yw kō֖l šiləṭē֥y hagibwōriym.

verses.he: שְׁנֵ֥י שָׁדַ֛יִךְ כִּשְׁנֵ֥י עֳפָרִ֖ים תְּאוֹמֵ֣י צְבִיָּ֑ה הָרוֹעִ֖ים בַּשּׁוֹשַׁנִּֽים׃
verses.en: Your two breasts are like two fawns, twins of a gazelle, grazing among the lilies.
verses.tr: šənē֥y šāda֛yikə kišənē֥y ʿŏpāri֖ym təʾwōmē֣y ṣəbiyā֑h hārwōʿi֖ym bašwōšaniym.

verses.he: עַ֤ד שֶׁיָּפ֨וּחַ֙ הַיּ֔וֹם וְנָ֖סוּ הַצְּלָלִ֑ים אֵ֤לֶךְ לִי֙ אֶל־הַ֣ר הַמּ֔וֹר וְאֶל־גִּבְעַ֖ת הַלְּבוֹנָֽה׃
verses.en: Until the day breathes and the shadows flee, I will go to the mountain of myrrh and to the hill of frankincense.
verses.tr: ʿa֤d šeyāp֨wḥa֙ hay֔wōm wənā֖sw haṣəlāli֑ym ʾē֤lekə liy֙ ʾel-ha֣r ham֔wōr wəʾel-gibəʿa֖t haləbwōnāh.

verses.he: כֻּלָּ֤ךְ יָפָה֙ רַעְיָתִ֔י וּמ֖וּם אֵ֥ין בָּֽךְ׃
verses.en: You are altogether beautiful, my love; there is no blemish in you.
verses.tr: kulā֤kə yāpāh֙ raʿəyāti֔y wm֖wm ʾē֥yn bākə.

verses.he: אִתִּ֤י מִלְּבָנוֹן֙ כַּלָּ֔ה אִתִּ֖י מִלְּבָנ֣וֹן תָּב֑וֹאִי תָּשׁ֣וּרִי ׀ מֵרֹ֣אשׁ אֲמָנָ֗ה מֵרֹ֤אשׁ שְׂנִיר֙ וְחֶרְמ֔וֹן מִמְּעֹנ֣וֹת אֲרָי֔וֹת מֵֽהַרְרֵ֖י נְמֵרִֽים׃
verses.en: Come with me from Lebanon, bride; come with me from Lebanon. Descend from the peak of Amana, from the peak of Senir and Hermon, from the dens of lions, from the mountains of leopards.
verses.tr: ʾiti֤y miləbānwōn֙ kalā֔h ʾiti֖y miləbān֣wōn tāb֑wōʾiy tāš֣wriy | mērō֣ʾš ʾămānā֗h mērō֤ʾš šəniyr֙ wəḥerəm֔wōn miməʿōn֣wōt ʾărāy֔wōt mēharərē֖y nəmēriym.

verses.he: לִבַּבְתִּ֖נִי אֲחֹתִ֣י כַלָּ֑ה לִבַּבְתִּ֨ינִי֙ באחד מֵעֵינַ֔יִךְ בְּאַחַ֥ד עֲנָ֖ק מִצַּוְּרֹנָֽיִךְ׃
verses.en: You have captivated my heart, my sister, my bride; you have captivated my heart with one glance of your eyes, with one bead of your necklace.
verses.tr: libabəti֖niy ʾăḥōti֣y kalā֑h libabəti֨yniy֙ bʾḥd mēʿēyna֔yikə bəʾaḥa֥d ʿănā֖q miṣawərōnāyikə.

verses.he: מַה־יָּפ֥וּ דֹדַ֖יִךְ אֲחֹתִ֣י כַלָּ֑ה מַה־טֹּ֤בוּ דֹדַ֨יִךְ֙ מִיַּ֔יִן וְרֵ֥יחַ שְׁמָנַ֖יִךְ מִכָּל־בְּשָׂמִֽים׃
verses.en: How beautiful is your love, my sister, my bride! How much better is your love than wine, and the fragrance of your oils than all spices.
verses.tr: mah-yāp֥w dōda֖yikə ʾăḥōti֣y kalā֑h mah-ṭō֤bw dōda֨yikə֙ miya֔yin wərē֥yḥa šəmāna֖yikə mikāl-bəšāmiym.

verses.he: נֹ֛פֶת תִּטֹּ֥פְנָה שִׂפְתוֹתַ֖יִךְ כַּלָּ֑ה דְּבַ֤שׁ וְחָלָב֙ תַּ֣חַת לְשׁוֹנֵ֔ךְ וְרֵ֥יחַ שַׂלְמֹתַ֖יִךְ כְּרֵ֥יחַ לְבָנֽוֹן׃
verses.en: Honeycomb drips from your lips, bride; honey and milk are under your tongue, and the fragrance of your garments is like the fragrance of Lebanon.
verses.tr: nō֛pet tiṭō֥pənāh šipətwōta֖yikə kalā֑h dəba֤š wəḥālāb֙ ta֣ḥat ləšwōnē֔kə wərē֥yḥa šaləmōta֖yikə kərē֥yḥa ləbānwōn.

verses.he: גַּ֥ן נָע֖וּל אֲחֹתִ֣י כַלָּ֑ה גַּ֥ל נָע֖וּל מַעְיָ֥ן חָתֽוּם׃
verses.en: A garden locked is my sister, my bride; a spring locked, a fountain sealed.
verses.tr: ga֥n nāʿ֖wl ʾăḥōti֣y kalā֑h ga֥l nāʿ֖wl maʿəyā֥n ḥātwm.

verses.he: שְׁלָחַ֨יִךְ֙ פַּרְדֵּ֣ס רִמּוֹנִ֔ים עִ֖ם פְּרִ֣י מְגָדִ֑ים כְּפָרִ֖ים עִם־נְרָדִֽים׃
verses.en: Your shoots are an orchard of pomegranates with choice fruits—henna with nard,
verses.tr: šəlāḥa֨yikə֙ parədē֣s rimwōni֔ym ʿi֖m pəri֣y məgādi֑ym kəpāri֖ym ʿim-nərādiym.

verses.he: נֵ֣רְדְּ וְכַרְכֹּ֗ם קָנֶה֙ וְקִנָּמ֔וֹן עִ֖ם כָּל־עֲצֵ֣י לְבוֹנָ֑ה מֹ֚ר וַאֲהָל֔וֹת עִ֖ם כָּל־רָאשֵׁ֥י בְשָׂמִֽים׃
verses.en: nard and saffron, calamus and cinnamon, with all trees of frankincense; myrrh and aloes, with all chief spices.
verses.tr: nē֣rədə wəkarəkō֗m qāneh֙ wəqinām֔wōn ʿi֖m kāl-ʿăṣē֣y ləbwōnā֑h mō֚r waʾăhāl֔wōt ʿi֖m kāl-rāʾšē֥y bəšāmiym.

verses.he: מַעְיַ֣ן גַּנִּ֔ים בְּאֵ֖ר מַ֣יִם חַיִּ֑ים וְנֹזְלִ֖ים מִן־לְבָנֽוֹן׃
verses.en: A garden fountain, a well of living waters, flowing down from Lebanon.
verses.tr: maʿəya֣n gani֔ym bəʾē֖r ma֣yim ḥayi֑ym wənōzəli֖ym min-ləbānwōn.

verses.he: ע֤וּרִי צָפוֹן֙ וּב֣וֹאִי תֵימָ֔ן הָפִ֥יחִי גַנִּ֖י יִזְּל֣וּ בְשָׂמָ֑יו יָבֹ֤א דוֹדִי֙ לְגַנּ֔וֹ וְיֹאכַ֖ל פְּרִ֥י מְגָדָֽיו׃
verses.en: Awake, north wind, and come, south; blow upon my garden—let its spices flow. Let my beloved come into his garden and eat its choice fruits.
verses.tr: ʿ֤wriy ṣāpwōn֙ wb֣wōʾiy tēymā֔n hāpi֥yḥiy gani֖y yizəl֣w bəšāmā֑yw yābō֤ʾ dwōdiy֙ ləgan֔wō wəyōʾka֖l pəri֥y məgādāyw.

grammar.note: Repeated address frames the description as direct praise and intensifies focus.
Similes dominate; כְּ introduces the comparison.
שֶׁ introduces relative clauses and complements (‘that/which…’).
Body-part nouns regularly take 2fs suffixes for ‘your …’.
Imperatives drive invitation imagery and shift from description to address.

exercises.q: List three similes introduced by כְּ in 4:1–4.
exercises.a: כְּעֵדֶר הָעִזִּים; כְּעֵדֶר הַקְּצוּבוֹת; כְּמִגְדַּל דָּוִיד.

exercises.q: What does the suffix -ֵךְ / -ַיִךְ indicate (e.g., עֵינַיִךְ)?
Tag the imagery in 4:13–15 using the controlled vocabulary.

exercises.a: Exclusive, protected intimacy expressed through enclosure/spring imagery.
